_about: Per-part inputs for scripts/bank_air_cand.py. Dimensions are datasheet maxima where given (w = thickness, stacked along y; h = height; l = length along x, the flow direction). I35 / I40 = the vendor's permissible RMS current at 35 / 40 kHz on its own dT basis dT_v (T_A <= 85 C). Sources per row; c34 ratios from PS c34-bank-margin/results/bank_margin.json (J worst share 0.2165, I_part 6.062 A at 28 A).
